# PUDL

> PUDL 2026.9.1.dev40 documentation


2016-2026, Catalyst Cooperative, CC-BY-4.0

## Pages in this subsection

- [pudl.transform](index.html.md): Modules implementing the “Transform” step of the PUDL ETL pipeline.
- [pudl.transform.censuspep](censuspep/index.html.md): Transform Census PEP FIPS codes data.
- [pudl.transform.classes](classes/index.html.md): Classes for defining &amp; coordinating the transformation of tabular data sources.
- [pudl.transform.eia](eia/index.html.md): Code for transforming EIA data that pertains to more than one EIA Form.
- [pudl.transform.eia176](eia176/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA176 data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eia191](eia191/index.html.md): Transform EIA Form 191 monthly underground natural gas storage data.
- [pudl.transform.eia860](eia860/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA860 data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eia860m](eia860m/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA860m data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eia861](eia861/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA861 data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eia923](eia923/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA923 data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eia930](eia930/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA930 data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eiaaeo](eiaaeo/index.html.md): Transform raw AEO tables into normalized assets.
- [pudl.transform.eiaapi](eiaapi/index.html.md): Clean and normalize EIA bulk electricity data.
- [pudl.transform.epacems](epacems/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EPA CEMS data tables.
- [pudl.transform.epamats](epamats/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EPA MATS data tables.
- [pudl.transform.ferc](ferc/index.html.md): Module for shared helpers for FERC Form transforms.
- [pudl.transform.ferc1](ferc1/index.html.md): Classes &amp; functions to process FERC Form 1 data before loading into the PUDL DB.
- [pudl.transform.ferc714](ferc714/index.html.md): Transformation of the FERC Form 714 data.
- [pudl.transform.ferccid](ferccid/index.html.md): Clean the FERC Company Identifier table.
- [pudl.transform.ferceqr](ferceqr/index.html.md): Transform FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) data.
- [pudl.transform.gridpathratoolkit](gridpathratoolkit/index.html.md): Transformations of the GridPath RA Toolkit renewable generation profiles.
- [pudl.transform.nrelatb](nrelatb/index.html.md): Transform NREL ATB data into well normalized, cleaned tables.
- [pudl.transform.params](params/index.html.md): A subpackage for defining data source-specific transformation parameters.
- [pudl.transform.params.ferc1](params/ferc1/index.html.md): FERC 1 specific transformation parameters.
- [pudl.transform.phmsagas](phmsagas/index.html.md): Classes &amp; functions to process PHMSA natural gas data before loading into the PUDL DB.
- [pudl.transform.rus](rus/index.html.md): Code for transforming RUS data that pertains to more than one RUS Form.
- [pudl.transform.rus12](rus12/index.html.md): Transform the RUS12 tables.
- [pudl.transform.rus7](rus7/index.html.md): Transform the RUS7 tables.
- [pudl.transform.sec10k](sec10k/index.html.md): Transformations and standardizations for SEC 10-K data tables.
- [pudl.transform.vcerare](vcerare/index.html.md): Transformations of the Vibrant Clean Energy Resource Adequacy Renewable Energy (RARE) Power Dataset.
